project_name: 架構收斂與 POC 瘦身
user_value: Kent obtains a revision-bound, secret-safe QNow PoC acceptance receipt: three hosted actors prove assignment, tenant isolation, exact-once claim and readback, with cleanup to zero remainder.
hypothesis: If we land the three green PRs through the ship stations and then run DEV-37 as one dispatched, recorded acceptance, then the QNow PoC closes with a receipt an independent validation can read, instead of staying blocked behind unmerged prerequisites.
wedge: Kent as FO on iamcxa/qnow only, kc-ship-flow installed locally from main. This batch: (1) DEV-25, DEV-35, DEV-36 — existing PRs #1177/#1175/#1174 taken through review → e2e → merge → close with a batch record (no new build); (2) DEV-37 rewritten into an admissible Brief (Accepted outcome, Non-goals, ACs from its own 完成條件/單次執行範圍) and dispatched once DEV-35/36 land. Not in it: DEV-17..23 (architecture tickets, one paragraph each — a separate plan session), DEV-23 (blocked by DEV-37), qnow's own docs/ship commission and retiring qnow's docs/ship-flow (next batch).
outcome: The three prerequisite PRs are merged with review dispositions and an e2e result in a qnow batch record; DEV-37 produces the acceptance receipt its 完成條件 names (revision-bound, secret-safe, handed to independent validation) in a single run with cleanup verified to zero remainder; the batch closes with a validated close receipt.
falsifier: Any of: a prerequisite PR is merged without a review disposition in the batch record; DEV-37 needs a second deploy or a retry to pass; the acceptance receipt names a secret, PII, URL or raw provider error; cleanup leaves a non-zero census.

premises.statement: Doing nothing leaves #1174/#1175/#1177 open (green since 2026-09-01) and DEV-37 blocked; the PoC has no acceptance receipt.

The existing partial solution is hand merges from the building chat plus DEV-37's detailed run script in its own body; kc-ship-flow's stations exist on main and can run on an existing PR without a worker Evidence block only at the review/e2e/merge/close stations (accept needs a block — recorded as not applicable for pre-built PRs).

Premise falsifier — remove the approach (ship stations + one dispatched DEV-37): the outcome cannot hold, because without a recorded run the receipt is a chat transcript, and without merging the prerequisites DEV-37 cannot start.

exit: DEV-25, DEV-35, DEV-36 merged with review dispositions and an e2e result recorded in a qnow batch.
DEV-37's acceptance receipt exists and its cleanup census is zero; DEV-37 Done.
One question to the Captain inside the batch at most: who holds the six secrets for the DEV-37 run (a cloud worker with provisioned env, or Kent's own machine).

journey.start: three green PRs idle and DEV-37 blocked
journey.end: acceptance receipt in hand, PoC closable
journey.observable: the batch record lists three merges with dispositions, one DEV-37 run log, one receipt, cleanup census 0

issue_cut.note: DEV-25/35/36 need Accepted outcome/Non-goals/AC sections added from their existing 目的/範圍/驗收 text to pass L4; DEV-37 the same. Rewrites are conversions of existing text, shown to the Captain before admission.

material_risk: DEV-37 runs against real hosted infrastructure with six production/functions secrets held in memory and allows exactly one deploy; a local subagent cannot hold those secrets. The run needs either a Conductor cloud worker whose image/env carries them, or Kent running it. This is the one decision the batch needs before dispatching DEV-37.
